answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. An honest proof costs 201 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 481 of them, which totals 96681 POA. A jetty from a stranger, a quill from a ledger, a cipher from a nursery — three keepers who never met, telling one story. No mask rides free: 201 POA and 39 minutes apiece, which is 96681 POA and 18759 minutes for 481. This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Millwright rice bran milled at the sifting loft, and the receipt must read each rice is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature.
